description:
#See Miami from a totally different and refreshing perspective, from the water. This fun 1.5hour boat cruise takes you through the waters around this beautiful city, plus a three hour bike rental.

##Duration
3 Hour Tour includes 90 minute boat ride 
Plus a 3 Hour Bike Rental (Same or different day) 

##About
**Tour**
See Miami from a totally different and refreshing perspective, from the water. This fun 1.5hour boat cruise takes you through the waters around this beautiful city. Learn about the history of Miami, and get a great glance at this magical city. After the cruise, enjoy the complimentary 3 hours bike rental to explore South Beach on any date of your choosing. Start by getting picked up at your hotel in South Beach, or at our shop.

Hit the water with a fully narrated sightseeing boat cruise. Cruise through Biscayne Bay, see the Downtown Miami skyline, the Port of Miami, Fisher Island, and Millionaire’s Row. Purchase beverages and light snacks on board during the 90-minute cruise.

**Bike Rental**
Explore South Beach by bicycle, an excellent way to see Miami Beach even further. Ride through glamorous SoBe, and experience a tropical paradise. Ride past the Versace Mansion, Star Island, the vibrant Lincoln Road outdoor mall, Ocean Drive and the Art Deco District, South Pointe Park, and more.

On a day of your choosing, please come to our shop and pick up your free bike rental for 3 hours to explore South Beach. Includes a bicycle, helmet, bike lock, and bottled water.  bike a helmet, and bike lock.
